summary: Turn heads instantly. This vivid, shocking coral lipstick delivers maximum pigment and a creamy finish for a vibrant, summer-ready statement.
technical_overview: Offered at $28.0 for 3.5g, this KoColor LIPSTICK is expertly formulated with Ricinus Communis (Castor) Seed Oil, Carnauba Wax, Red 6 Lake, Yellow 5 Lake, Titanium Dioxide. Delivering a high-fidelity Electric Coral color profile (`#FF4040`), it leverages advanced engineering via high-purity pigments and volatile carriers. For optimal chromatic impact, apply directly to a clean, prepped surface.
